articles.title: Reimagining work: How Pythians internal AI playbook delivers customer ROI
articles.summary: Pythian uses Google Clouds Gemini Enterprise to discover how enterprise AI delivers ROI.
articles.detail: Pythian rolled out Google Clouds Gemini Enterprise across their 500-person company in 27 countries, discovering how enterprise AI actually delivers ROI.

articles.title: Deploy personal AI agents with Cloud Run instances
articles.summary: Google introduces Cloud Run instances for low-cost, high-performance way to run long-lived, stateful workloads such as AI agents.
articles.detail: Cloud Run instances let users do just that. Consider AI agents such as OpenClaw or Hermes , which are intended for individual developers or personal use.

articles.title: Simplify your resilience testing strategy with Fault Injection Testing
articles.summary: Google introduces Fault Injection Testing to help maintain availability and reliability during adverse events.
articles.detail: Fault Injection Testing is designed to guarantee high availability has become increasingly difficult because of the complexity of modern distributed systems.

articles.title: Your chance to start building AI agents from the absolute basics
articles.summary: Google introduces Agent Valley , a free, 5-week live learning series designed to take users from scratch to building their very own hands-on agent.
articles.detail: The best way to learn is by doing, which is why we built Agent Valley .

articles.title: Building Multi-Region Active-Active Architectures with CloudFront VPC origins and Advanced Routing
articles.summary: AWS introduces Amazon CloudFront VPC origins, which provides direct connectivity to private origins.
articles.detail: Building a multi-region active-active architecture with Amazon CloudFront requires careful coordination of traffic routing to address performance, traffic management, and session consistency requirements, along with automated failover to maintain availability during regional events.
